They were trained athletes; their father had been a circus performer, and under peculiar circumstances the two brothers had been trained for the profession, but owing to reasons satisfactory to themselves, and as recorded in previous records of their exploits, they had decided become detectives, and had so acted upon three occasions as recorded in Nos.

arxiv-1808-06025.title: Optimization of LTE Radio Resource Block Allocation for Maritime Channels
arxiv-1808-06025.creator: Amit Kachroo 1 , Mehmet Kemal Ozdemir 2 , Hatice Tekiner-Mogulkoc 3
arxiv-1808-06025.description: Abstract In this study, we describe the behavior of LTE over the sea and investigate the problem of radio resource block allocation in such SINR limited maritime channels. For simulations of such sea environment, we considered a network scenario of Bosphorus Strait in Istanbul, Turkey with different number of ships ferrying between two ports at a given time.

arxiv-2102-06214.title: Gravitational production of dark matter during reheating Preprint: UMN–TH–4008/21
arxiv-2102-06214.creator: Yann Mambrini a, Keith A. Olive b
arxiv-2102-06214.description: Abstract We consider the direct s s -channel gravitational production of dark matter during the reheating process. Independent of the identity of the dark matter candidate or its non-gravitational interactions, the gravitational process is always present and provides a minimal production mechanism.

arxiv-2107-02578.title: Noisy Boolean Hidden Matching with Applications
arxiv-2107-02578.creator: Michael Kapralov, Amulya Musipatla, Jakab Tardos, David P. Woodruff, Samson Zhou
arxiv-2107-02578.description: Abstract The Boolean Hidden Matching (BHM) problem, introduced in a seminal paper of Gavinsky et. al. [STOC’07], has played an important role in the streaming lower bounds for graph problems such as triangle and subgraph counting, maximum matching, MAX-CUT, Schatten p p -norm approximation, maximum acyclic subgraph, testing bipartiteness, k k -connectivity, and cycle-freeness.

arxiv-2209-04717.title: Bulk Viscosity of Relativistic n ​ p ​ e ​ μ npe\mu Matter inNeutron-Star Mergers
arxiv-2209-04717.creator: Mark Alford \orcidicon, Arus Harutyunyan * \orcidicon, Armen Sedrakian \orcidicon
arxiv-2209-04717.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Mark Alford \orcidicon, Arus Harutyunyan * \orcidicon, Armen Sedrakian \orcidicon. We discuss the bulk viscosity of hot and dense n ​ p ​ e ​ μ npe\mu matter arising from weak-interaction direct Urca processes. We consider two regimes of interest: (a) the neutrino-transparent regime with T ≤ T tr T\leq T_{\rm tr} ( T tr ≃ 5 ÷ 10 T_{\rm tr}\simeq 5\div 10 MeV is the neutrino-trapping temperature); and (b) the neutrino-trapped regime with T ≥ T tr T\geq T_{\rm tr} .

arxiv-2302-09895.title: Field evidence for the initiation of isolated aeolian sand patches
arxiv-2302-09895.description: Abstract Sand patches are one of the precursors to early-stage protodunes and occur widely in both desert and coastal aeolian environments. Here we show field evidence of a mechanism to explain the initiation of sand patches on non-erodible surfaces, such as desert gravels and moist beaches.

arxiv-2303-03557.title: Level set topology optimization of metamaterial-based heat manipulators using isogeometric analysis
arxiv-2303-03557.creator: Chintan Jansari, Stéphane P.A. Bordas, Elena Atroshchenko
arxiv-2303-03557.description: Abstract We exploit level set topology optimization to find the optimal material distribution for metamaterial-based heat manipulators. The level set function, geometry, and solution field are parameterized using the non-uniform rational B-spline (NURBS) basis functions in order to take advantage of easy control of smoothness and continuity.

It assigns each document a unique identifier, known as the DocID, and employs a generative model to directly generate the relevant DocID for the input query. arxiv-2402-16214.title: Products and Powers of Principal Symmetric Ideals
arxiv-2402-16214.creator: Eric Dannetun, Bruce Fang, Riccardo Formenti, Bo Y. Gao, Juliann Geraci, Ross Kogel, Yuelin Li, Shreya Mandal, Vinuge Rupasinghe, Alexandra Seceleanu, Duc Van Khanh Tran, Noah Walker
arxiv-2402-16214.description: Abstract . Principal symmetric ideals were recently introduced by Harada, Seceleanu, and Şega in [ HSS ] , where their homological properties are elucidated. They are ideals generated by the orbit of a single polynomial under permutations of variables in a polynomial ring.

arxiv-2404-17848.title: Generation of kink-antikink pairs through the excitation of an oscillon in the ϕ 4 \phi^{4} model
arxiv-2404-17848.creator: Fabiano C. Simas 1,3 and E. da Hora 2,3
arxiv-2404-17848.description: Abstract We examine the oscillon decay in a model with a single scalar field and two asymmetric fundamental states. Specifically, we verify how the evolution of an initially excited oscillon leads to the formation of antikink-kink pairs in the presence of a centered long-lived pulse.

arxiv-2503-16311.title: Structured-Noise Masked Modeling for Video, Audio and Beyond
arxiv-2503-16311.creator: Aritra Bhowmik Fida Mohammad Thoker Carlos Hinojosa, Bernard Ghanem Cees G. M. Snoek
arxiv-2503-16311.description: Abstract Masked modeling has emerged as a powerful self-supervised learning framework, but existing methods largely rely on random masking, disregarding the structural properties of different modalities. In this work, we introduce structured noise-based masking, a simple yet effective approach that naturally aligns with the spatial, temporal, and spectral characteristics of video and audio data.

arxiv-2509-04729.title: CD-Mamba: Cloud Detection with Long-Range Spatial Dependency Modeling
arxiv-2509-04729.creator: Tianxiang Xue, Jiayi Zhao, Jingsheng Li, Changlu Chen, Kun Zhan1. School of Information Science and Engineering, Lanzhou University2. Faculty of Data Science, City University of Macau, Macau, China https://github.com/kunzhan/CD-Mamba
arxiv-2509-04729.description: Abstract Remote sensing images are frequently obscured by cloud cover, posing significant challenges to data integrity and reliability. Effective cloud detection requires addressing both short-range spatial redundancies and long-range atmospheric similarities among cloud patches. Convolutional neural networks are effective at capturing local spatial dependencies, while Mamba has strong capabilities in modeling long-range dependencies.

arxiv-2512-08772.title: De novo generation of functional terpene synthases using TpsGPT
arxiv-2512-08772.creator: Hamsini Ramanathan, Roman Bushuiev, Matouš Soldát, Jiří Kohout, Téo Hebra, Joshua David Smith, Josef Sivic, Tomáš Pluskal
arxiv-2512-08772.description: Abstract Terpene synthases (TPS) are a key family of enzymes responsible for generating the diverse terpene scaffolds that underpin many natural products, including front-line anticancer drugs such as Taxol. However, de novo TPS design through directed evolution is costly and slow.

plos-pone-0008156.description: PLOS ONE research article. Hepatitis E virus (HEV) is a zoonotic pathogen of which several species of animal were reported as reservoirs. pmc-11672064.title: Relationship between combat-related traumatic injury and ultrashort term heart rate variability in a UK military cohort: findings from the ADVANCE study
pmc-11672064.creator: Rabeea Maqsood, S Schofield, A N Bennett, A MJ Bull, N T Fear, P Cullinan, A Khattab, C J Boos
pmc-11672064.description: IntroductionCombat-related traumatic injury (CRTI) has been linked to an increased cardiovascular disease (CVD) risk. The long-term impact of CRTI on heart rate variability (HRV)—a robust CVD risk marker—has not been explored. This study investigated the relationship between CRTI, the mechanism of injury and injury severity on HRV.

pmc-11673236.title: Applying an Indigenous Connectedness Framework to Examine Environmental Risk and Protective Factors for Urban American Indian Children’s Executive Function Development
pmc-11673236.creator: Alexis Merculief, Monica Tsethlikai, Felix Muniz
pmc-11673236.description: Indigenous frameworks suggest environmental risk and protective factors for American Indian (AI) children’s development can be understood in terms of connecting and disconnecting forces in five domains: spirituality, family, intergenerational ties, community, and environment/land. This study examined the prevalence of these forces among 156 urban AI parents and their children (mean age = 10.69, SD = 1.

pmc-12362858.title: Dysregulated lipid metabolism in kidney stone pathogenesis: a literature review of mechanistic insights and therapeutic implications
pmc-12362858.creator: Quan Wen, Qiuyu Li, Haoji Zhou, Boyan Su, Yalin Ren, Qiqi He
pmc-12362858.description: Kidney stone disease (KSD) is a globally prevalent urinary system disorder whose pathogenesis involves complex interactions among metabolic, genetic, and environmental factors. Although the role of glucose metabolism in KSD has been widely studied, the impact of lipid metabolism abnormalities remains unclear.

pmc-12467496.title: A Novel Protocol for Integrated Assessment of Upper Limbs Using the Optoelectronic Motion Analysis System: Validation and Usability in Healthy People
pmc-12467496.creator: Luca Emanuele Molteni, Luigi Piccinini, Daniele Panzeri, Ettore Micheletti, Giuseppe Andreoni, Christina Zong-Hao Ma, Hong Fu
pmc-12467496.description: (1) Background: Upper limb (UL) function plays a central role in daily life, enabling essential tasks such as reaching, grasping, and eating. While numerous tools exist to evaluate UL kinematics, their application in pediatric populations is often limited by a lack of age-specific validation.

pmc-12764805.title: Data assimilation reveals behavioral dynamics of sea cucumbers as a model for slow-moving benthic animals
pmc-12764805.creator: Tsutomu Takagi, Yuto Tanaka, Erica Sasano, Kouki Kanda, Yuichi Sakai
pmc-12764805.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Understanding the movement behavior of Japanese sea cucumbers (Apostichopus japonicus) is essential for ecological research and fisheries management. However, tracking their locomotion is challenging due to their slow movement and environmental variability. In this study, we employed acoustic telemetry combined with a data assimilation approach using the Kalman filter to estimate movement trajectories with high accuracy, overcoming the limitations of traditional visual tracking methods.

pmc-12830904.title: Automated speech-fluency explanations for schizophrenia diagnosis
pmc-12830904.creator: Rok Rajher, Mila Marinković, Polona Rus Prelog, Jure Žabkar
pmc-12830904.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Schizophrenia is a chronic and severe mental disorder that still relies on time-intensive, clinician-administered assessments. Although several automated approaches have been proposed to support diagnosis, these systems often lack the level of explainability necessary for informed clinical decision-making.

pmc-12860088.title: Comparison of the metabolome of follicular fluid in GnRH agonist versus antagonist protocols during in vitro fertilization cycles
pmc-12860088.creator: Chengguang Sun, Shen Zhang, Xianglan Tang, Ting-li Han, Fan He
pmc-12860088.description: PurposeTo conduct a comparative metabolomic analysis of follicular fluid (FF) from patients undergoing in vitro fertilization (IVF) cycles under GnRH agonist versus antagonist protocols, aiming to identify protocol-specific metabolic signatures and explore their associations with embryological outcomes, thereby elucidating the metabolic basis for outcome differences and identifying modifiable metabolic factors to expand the scope for improving IVF outcomes.

pmc-13035968.title: You sure about that? The effects of textual and image-based Skepticism on belief in dubious social-media claims
pmc-13035968.creator: Emily R Spearing, Juliana Garib Jankauskas, Eryn J Newman, Ullrich K H Ecker
pmc-13035968.description: On social media, people often react to posts using both written comments and images. While prior work has shown that these reactions can influence belief in claims, it has often conflated signals of (dis)endorsement with justifications of dissent. It is therefore unclear whether skeptical comments that express doubt about a claim’s veracity without providing informational content can reduce claim belief.

pmc-13248157.title: Bone Graft Harvesting Site Morbidity in Donor Area (Anterior Iliac Crest): A Retrospective Study
pmc-13248157.creator: Bhaskar Borgohain, Tashi G Khonglah
pmc-13248157.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Introduction:In orthopedic practice, autologous bone grafts are routinely employed to aid fracture healing in non-unions. The anterior iliac crest (AIC) is readily accessible, and a standard harvesting site in adults, yielding a generous quantity of bone grafts. Although autologous bone graft remains the gold standard, harvesting graft from the AIC may potentially risk donor site morbidity that is highlighted, especially in the western literature.

pmc-13362547.title: Interfacial Electron Engineering for Nitrate-to-Ammonia Electrocatalysis: Mechanistic Insights and Design Strategies
pmc-13362547.creator: Xuzhi Liu, Jianqiang Zhu, Zaidong Wang, Han Meng, Yu Ma, Lishi Jiao, Sen Chen, Jian Qi, Huan Wang
pmc-13362547.description: The electrocatalytic nitrate reduction reaction (NO3RR) enables sustainable ammonia synthesis from nitrate waste, yet its complex mechanism and severe competition from the hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) demand precise control over interfacial electronic structures. This review provides a mechanistic overview of interfacial electron engineering for NO3RR via charge transfer, d-band center modulation, and d-p orbital coupling.

pmc-13491881.title: Validity and reliability of the Amharic version Revised Child Anxiety and Depression Scale (RCADS-25) in pediatric oncology
pmc-13491881.creator: Tenaw Gualu Melesse, Janita Pak Chun Chau, William Ho Cheung Li, Kai Chow Choi, Mulugeta Ayalew Yimer, Abdulkadir Mohamedsaid Gidey
pmc-13491881.description: BackgroundThe short form of the Revised Child Anxiety and Depression Scale (RCADS-25) has been frequently used for assessing anxiety and depression in clinical and community samples. However, the Amharic version of RCADS-25 (RCADS-25(A)) has not been validated. This study aimed to evaluate the validity and reliability of RCADS-25(A) in pediatric oncology.MethodsThis study included 142 children aged 8–18 years.

pmc-13510016.title: Polymer Composition Modulates Dental Stem Cell Response and Mineralization in Electrospun Scaffolds for Hard Tissue Regeneration
pmc-13510016.creator: Caroline Anselmi, Sepideh Aminmansour, Igor Paulino Mendes Soares, Alexandre Henrique dos Reis-Prado, Sahar Aminmansour, Owen Liepman, Renan Dal-Fabbro, Josimeri Hebling, Marco C. Bottino

pmc-13573248.title: Adenosine 5′-Carboxamide-Based Inhibitors of METTL1
pmc-13573248.creator: Olga Bobileva, Francesco Nai, Sandija Niedrite, Lidia Mayordomo Soler, Irena Leite, Amedeo Caflisch
pmc-13573248.description: METTL1 is the human RNA methyltransferase that catalyzes the methylation of N7-guanosine in RNA. Overexpression of METTL1 has been linked to cancer, and increasing evidence supports the therapeutic potential of METTL1 inhibition in oncology. In this study, we have optimized a series of adenosine 5′-carboxamide derivatives as METTL1 inhibitors through structure-guided modifications of a previously discovered hit compound.

pmc-13659829.title: Lactate Promotes Liver Regeneration by Increasing Fatty Acid Oxidation Through GCN5-Mediated H3K9 Lactylation
pmc-13659829.creator: Xun Qiu, Hanzhi Xu, Lijun Meng, Yunguo Lei, Yawen Tan, Zunqiang Xiao, Xiao Tang, Xinyu Yang, Fengqiang Gao, Yingying Zhang, Libin Dong, Zhoucheng Wang, Yuqi Gong, Xinyang Zhong, Nasha Qiu, Ruhong Zhou, Kai Wang, Xiao Xu
pmc-13659829.description: Background & AimsLactylation has been implicated in the repair and regeneration of multiple organs, including the skin and the heart. The liver serves as a vital organ for lactate metabolism, whereas the roles of lactate and lactylation during liver regeneration remain unclear.MethodsMice were subjected to 70% partial hepatectomy, and the liver-to-body weight ratio and proliferative markers were measured.

pmc-13694372.title: Spatio-temporal inequalities in vulvar cancer mortality in Spain, 1999–2023: a nationwide Bayesian analysis
pmc-13694372.creator: Lucía Cayuela, José-Juan Pereyra-Rodríguez, Julián Librero, María Pastor-Valero, Aurelio Cayuela
pmc-13694372.description: ObjectiveTo conduct the first nationwide spatio-temporal analysis of vulvar cancer mortality in Spain, identifying geographical inequalities and temporal trends over 25 years.MethodsA population-based ecological study analyzed mortality data (1999–2023) across 52 Spanish provinces and autonomous cities. Expected deaths were calculated via indirect standardization. Hierarchical Bayesian spatio-temporal models were implemented using Integrated Nested Laplace Approximation (INLA).ResultsSpatial heterogeneity accounted for 68.
